color-no-hex.message: Hex literals are reserved for the five brand source colors in src/styles/global.css, landing.css, and tailwind.css. Use a brand token (var(--brand-*)) or oklch() elsewhere.

color-named.message: Named colors like 'white' or 'black' violate DESIGN.md §No-Pure-Neutral. Use var(--ink), var(--brand-neutral), or an oklch() value. 'transparent' / 'currentColor' are not named colors and are allowed.

function-disallowed-list.message: Use oklch() or color-mix(in oklab, …) — DESIGN.md picks OKLCH as the perceptual-uniform working space.
